acceptedAnswer.text: Digital Defense: The Role of AI in Modern Warfare is a plain-English guide to how AI is changing defence, intelligence, cybersecurity, and military decision-making.
It is written for curious readers, professionals, and policy-minded people who want a practical overview of AI in defence without technical waffle.
No. The book focuses on concepts, real-world use cases, and trade-offs rather than code or maths.

mainEntity.name: What will I get from it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You will get a grounded understanding of autonomous systems, predictive intelligence, cybersecurity, oversight, and the ethical issues that come with AI in warfare.
You can buy the ebook via the Amazon link on this page.
